description: Plan turning USDT or USDC into USD, EUR, GBP or AED in a company bank account: the indicative market value of the amount, the network fee to move the tokens now, each payout rail for that currency with the date the money should arrive if sent now (weekends and holidays included), the rules to check in that currency, a checklist before the first withdrawal, and the next step (a link to ask Align for a quote, plus a sign-up link where Align's convert page for the pair offers one). Indicative information, not a quote or an offer.

amount.description: Amount of the token to convert (optional)

beforeCutoff.description: Whether the payout leaves before the bank's cut-off that day (default true)

network.description: Network the tokens are on, e.g. tron, ethereum, solana, base (optional)

sendDate.description: Day the conversion is made, YYYY-MM-DD between 2026-11-01 and 2027-12-31 (default today, UTC)

name: plan_offramp
title: Plan a stablecoin off-ramp
